gloss: to unfold; to develop; to stage

definitions.gloss: to unfold; to develop; to carry out
definitions.explanation: To develop or execute an event, battle, argument, or performance over a period of time, often with dramatic or dynamic qualities.

examples.japanese: {両|りょう}チームは{熱戦|ねっせん}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた。
examples.english: Both teams engaged in a fierce battle.

examples.japanese: {議会|ぎかい}で{激|はげ}しい{議論|ぎろん}が{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた。
examples.english: A heated debate unfolded in the parliament.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}スペクタクルが{舞台|ぶたい}で{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられる。
examples.english: A grand spectacle will unfold on stage.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げない (negative)
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げて (te-form)
・{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる → {繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {繰|く}る (to reel, to turn) + {広|ひろ}げる (to spread)

The image is of unrolling a scroll or spreading something out.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{激戦|げきせん}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to wage a fierce battle
・{攻防|こうぼう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to exchange attacks and defenses
・{論争|ろんそう}を{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to carry on a controversy
・ドラマを{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる - to unfold a drama

REGISTER:
Often used in news reporting and formal writing to describe ongoing events with dramatic qualities.
